layouts.name: Pikes Peak Hillclimb
layouts.description: Draft open course: The event operator identifies the open Pikes Peak Highway climb from the mile-seven start to the summit. The planar source distance differs from the published event distance and supplied distance; the private timing positions agree with the source endpoints. Coordinates are unchanged independent OSM ways; no artificial closure or endpoint interpolation is added.
